channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: WTI plummets to near $82 as US economic pressure on Iran seems less risky
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), futures on NYMEX, trade 3% lower at around $82.00 during the European trading session on Tuesday.

item.title: British Pound hovers near six-month highs with investors awaiting key US events
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) remains practically flat for the second consecutive day against the US Dollar (USD), with markets on a “wait-and-see” stance, awaiting key US Inflation data on Wednesday and the Jackson Hole central bankers’ summit on Friday.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Strength intact with 0.7200 in focus against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note AUD/USD has slipped into short-term consolidation between 0.7135 and 0.7170 after last week’s sharp rise, but they still regard the broader uptrend as intact.

item.title: Euro: Recovery against US Dollar supported by data – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad reports EUR/USD is firmer but still below 1.1700 as Germany’s IFO survey rises to a one-year high, echoing Eurozone PMI and ZEW improvements.

item.title: Gold pauses near three-month high after sharp rally
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) loses ground on Tuesday after setting a fresh three-month high of $4,697 earlier in the Asian session. Traders appear to be booking some profits following the recent rally, which has pushed the Relative Strength Index (RSI) into overbought territory.

item.title: US Dollar: Debasement fears meet historical skepticism – MUFG
item.description: MUFG analysts Derek Halpenny and Abdul-Ahad Lockhart note that the Dollar Index (DXY) is consolidating after a modest rebound, even as markets focus on US fiscal concerns, Treasury buybacks and perceived USD debasement.

item.title: Indian Rupee jumps to weekly high amid lower Oil prices, declining US Yields
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opened almost flat against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, but there is a significant appreciation in India's afternoon trading hours.

item.title: Euro stands above 1.1650, supported by upbeat German macroeconomic data
item.description: The Euro (EUR) remains practically flat against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, trading above 1.1650, at a relatively short distance from the three-month highs, at 1.1710 hit last week.

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD holds onto early losses near $4,630, US Yields plunge
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) is down 0.4% to near $4,630 during the European trading session on Tuesday. The precious metal corrects after failing to extend the rally above $4,700 earlier in the day.

item.title: British Pound: Dovish repricing points to weakness against Euro – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole observes EUR/GBP has slipped back to the 0.8550-0.8560 area as the earlier Euro premium fades and bond market calm returns.

item.title: Euro advances against Japanese Yen as German business sentiment improves
item.description: EUR/JPY advances to around 185.85 on Tuesday at the time of writing, gaining 0.15% on the day.

item.title: Hungarian Forint: Holding firm against Euro below key resistance - Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale strategists expect Hungary's central bank, Magyar Nemzeti Bank (MNB), to cut rates by 25 bp to 5.50% today, with dovish July minutes and softer-than-expected inflation leaving room for further easing.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Tuesday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $67.82 per troy ounce, down 0.97% from the $68.48 it cost on Monday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: Tariff risks cloud outlook – Commerzbank
item.description: Michael Pfister at Commerzbank assesses the potential impact of higher US auto tariffs on Canada and the Canadian Dollar.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Range trade within 157.90 and 159.80 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann describe USD/JPY as locked in a range-trading phase, with a slightly firmer tone keeping the pair in a higher intraday band of 158.80–159.45.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD faces rejection near $70.00 as upside momentum fades
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) continues its struggle to make it through the $70.00 psychological mark and turns lower for the second straight day on Tuesday.

item.title: Indian Rupee: Range holds against US Dollar as inflows offset trade drag – DBS
item.description: DBS economist Radhika Rao observes that strong FCNR (B) swap inflows and higher FX reserves have not translated into significant Rupee gains, with USD/INR staying in a tight 95.50–96.00 range.

item.title: Dow Jones futures advance as tech stocks rebound ahead of looming Nvidia earnings
item.description: Dow Jones futures gain by 0.18%, trading around 53,590 during European hours on Tuesday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures advance by 0.28%, to trade near 7,690, and Nasdaq 100 futures rise by 0.58% to trade around 29,270.

item.title: Australian Dollar: CPI keeps RBA on hold bias – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole expects Australia’s July inflation data to show further moderation, consistent with no additional Reserve Bank of Australia hikes this year. He argues Governor Bullock is likely to stay hawkish, and even a small inflation surprise could lift AUD.

item.title: Hungarian Forint: MNB tone shift watched – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose expects Hungary's central bank, Magyar Nemzeti Bank (MNB), to cut its base rate by 25bp to 5.50%, but stresses that guidance will matter more for the Forint. While headline inflation has surprised on the downside, core and services pressures and energy risks persist.

item.title: Euro holds gains against Canadian Dollar on upbeat German IFO data
item.description: EUR/CAD extends its gains for the second consecutive day, trading around 1.6160 during the European hours on Tuesday. The currency cross remains stronger as the Euro (EUR) holds gains following the release of the German IFO business sentiment index data.

item.title: British Pound extends gains to fresh monthly peak, around mid-217.00s vs weaker Yen
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross catches fresh bids on Tuesday and climbs to its highest level since July 30, around mid-217.00s during the first half of the European session.

item.title: US Dollar: Policy crosscurrents shape outlook – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong highlight that renewed policy uncertainty and Federal Reserve (Fed) reaction risks are constraining US Dollar (USD) gains, even as higher US real yields and a resilient US economy limit downside.

item.title: British Pound: Upside bias toward 1.3700 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann describe GBP/USD price action as range-bound intraday between 1.3615 and 1.3660, with momentum indicators neutral.

item.title: Germany’s IFO Business Climate Index improves again, arriving at 88.8 vs. 87.2 estimates
item.description: The German IFO Institute Business Climate Index improves again. The sentiment data arrives higher at 88.8 in August from 86.7 in July, revised higher from 86.6. The data also beats estimates of 87.2.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Rally pauses below 1.3700
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) trades marginally higher against the US Dollar (USD) at around 1.3640 during the European trading session on Tuesday, even as the US Dollar Index (DXY) edges up, indicating strength in the British currency.

item.title: Gold: Path depends on yield regime shift – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny and Abdul-Ahad Lockhart highlight that Gold’s recent strength alongside USD weakness and higher US yields has not historically confirmed a debasement story.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Could surpass 1.3900 as break above 38.2% Fibo. comes into play
item.description: The USD/CAD pair is seen building on its recovery move from the 1.3730 region, or a three-month low touched last week, and gaining positive traction for the second straight day on Tuesday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar falls as US Dollar gains on safe-haven demand
item.description: NZD/USD extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around 0.5950 during the European hours on Tuesday. The currency pair faces downward pressure as the US Dollar (USD) gains strength from safe-haven demand driven by rising geopolitical tensions.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD slips below $68.50 despite revived debasement trading
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around $68.40 per troy ounce during the European hours on Tuesday. However, Silver may regain ground as US government interventions in the bond market revive the debasement trade.
